_readme: One place for every share card, favicon and theme-color tag. Swap files in public/, bump `version` (e.g. 4) so X/WhatsApp/iMessage refetch, then build + deploy. index.html's <!-- share:begin/end --> block and the /suomi page are both rendered from this file. v5 (30 Oct 2026): Iris's final navy player-window card + 'Record P' favicon with four tab states (favicons/<state>/, swapped by favicons/favicon-state.js); /suomi shares the main card and icons. v9 (31 Oct 2026): Boxing Cats share image; /suomi shares it. Favicon files are unchanged; their query string moves with version so the state swapper stays in step.
